biography.value:
WRETCHED PRISONER — CR 0 rescue NPC (run several, generic). A starved, beaten slave in the staging mine near Dhul Maldur; freed or extracted during the mine breakout. Escort liability — the cost of saving them.

Manual — Wretched: starved, beaten, exhausted — disadvantage on STR & CON checks and saves; can't Dash two rounds running.

Manual — Won't fight (RP): cowers, flees, or clings to rescuers; acts only if cornered. Needs escort/protecting through the breakout.

Manual — Desperate Surge (1/day): when freed, or when a rescuer takes a hit for them, adrenaline grants one extra move OR a Help action this turn.

abilities.name: Feeble Blow
abilities.desc: Melee attack with a fist or a scrap of debris: 1d4-1 bludgeoning (minimum 1) on a hit.
